name: Delhi Institute of Digital Marketing (DIDM)
slogan: Join the Momentum... Go Digital Go Global

leadership.directorMessageExcerpt: Digital marketing has revolutionized the way organizations conduct business and engage with target markets... DIDM is committed to equipping learners with practical knowledge, real-world simulations, and agency-level mastery to build thriving careers.

mission: To empower Indian people with the skillset of digital marketing, bridging academic learning with real industry demands through practical excellence.
vision: To be the number one digital marketing training provider across India, producing world-class digital marketers, entrepreneurs, and leaders.
